name: Diffusion Policy (BC only)
tagline: Pure behavior-cloning with a discrete-time diffusion actor — no critic, no Q-loss, no candidate reranking at inference.
pseudocode:
1. Init actor = DiscreteDiffusionSDE(DQLMlp, IdentityCondition(obs))
2. For each batch: $L = \mathrm{actor.update}(a, s)$ (denoising BC loss only)
3. EMA-update actor weights every K steps (after warmup)
4. Cosine LR schedule on actor optimizer
5. At inference: $a \sim \mathrm{actor.sample}(\text{prior}=0,\,\text{cond}=s)$, clip to $[-1,1]$
6. Single sample per env, no candidate reranking
diff_from_baseline: Chi et al., RSS 2023 ('Diffusion Policy', arXiv:2303.04137). Diffusion-only behavior cloning baseline; reduces dql_d4rl_mujoco.py to its BC component.

name: IDQL (Implicit Q-Learning)
tagline: Diffusion actor trained with BC plus an IQL twin-Q + value critic; at inference, sample N candidates and resample by softmax(advantage * beta).
pseudocode:
1. Actor: DiscreteDiffusionSDE(IDQLMlp); critics: IDQLQNet (twin) + IDQLVNet
2. Every other step train V with expectile loss: $|\tau - \mathbb{1}[(Q-V)<0]|\,(Q-V)^2$
3. TD target $y = r + \gamma(1-d) V(s')$; Q with $(q_1-y)^2 + (q_2-y)^2$; soft target update $\tau=0.005$
4. Actor: BC loss only on diffusion denoising, decoupled from critic
5. Inference: sample $N$ candidate actions per state
6. Score with adv $= Q(s,a) - V(s)$; resample $a$ via $\mathrm{multinomial}(\mathrm{softmax}(\beta\,\mathrm{adv}))$
diff_from_baseline: Hansen-Estruch et al., 2023 (IDQL, arXiv:2304.10573). Diffusion actor + IQL critic; advantage-weighted resampling at inference.

name: Diffusion Q-Learning (DQL)
tagline: Diffusion actor trained jointly with BC denoising loss and a guidance term that maximizes a learned twin-Q critic.
pseudocode:
1. Actor: DiscreteDiffusionSDE(DQLMlp); critic: twin-Q learned with TD on offline tuples
2. Per step: BC denoising loss $L_{BC}$ on $(s, a)$
3. Sample $\hat a \sim \mathrm{actor}(s)$; Q loss term $L_Q = -Q(s, \hat a)$
4. Actor loss: $L = L_{BC} + \eta\, L_Q$ (Q-guided diffusion)
5. Critic update with TD target $y = r + \gamma(1-d)\min_i Q'_i(s', a')$
6. Inference: single diffusion sample per env, no reranking
diff_from_baseline: Wang et al., ICLR 2023 ('Diffusion Policies as an Expressive Policy Class for Offline RL', arXiv:2208.06193). Cleandiffuser's dql_d4rl_mujoco template — BC + Q-guided diffusion actor with twin-Q critic.
